foliage.name: Silver sage clump
foliage.subject: a low asymmetric clump of thick elongated sage leaves, dusty pale silver-green tops, muted olive undersides, a few curled young leaves

foliage.name: Blue woodland sword fern
foliage.subject: an arching radial sword fern with long finely segmented but clearly painted fronds, blue-green shadows and restrained sage tips, NOT rounded paddle leaves

foliage.name: Copper bracken fan
foliage.subject: a spreading bracken fern with triangular branching fronds, dusty rust, tobacco and olive colours, a few green fronds tucked below

foliage.name: Low juniper cushion
foliage.subject: a low irregular evergreen juniper mound with sculpted needle sprays, deep blue-grey green foliage and a few muted steel-blue berries, visible short woody branch tips

foliage.name: Hazel undergrowth
foliage.subject: an open waist-high hazel bush, many distinct scalloped almond-shaped leaves on visible arching twigs, rich moss-green with gently bronze upper leaves, uneven silhouette

foliage.name: Russet bilberry patch
foliage.subject: a compact knee-high bilberry shrub with small oval painted leaves, muted burgundy russet and olive mixed together, scattered tiny blue berries; wider than tall

foliage.name: River willow scrub
foliage.subject: a loose low spreading willow shrub of thin drooping branches and long narrow leaves, soft sage-green and cool teal undersides, asymmetrical wispy but sharp silhouette

foliage.name: Young alder thicket
foliage.subject: a small waist-high multi-stem alder thicket with rounded serrated leaves, dark jade and forest green, visible warm brown stems; clearly a bush not a mature tree

foliage.name: Blue river sedge
foliage.subject: a dense low fountain of broad arching sedge blades, blue-green and sage shades, visibly broad ribbons instead of photographic hair, fan-like asymmetric silhouette

foliage.name: Ochre river reeds
foliage.subject: a small irregular clump of tall reeds with broad olive and straw leaves, five brown cattail seedheads at differing heights, gently leaning stems, no water or soil

foliage.name: Dry golden tussock
foliage.subject: a squat spreading bunchgrass tussock, broad painted curved ochre and straw blades with muted olive at the base, sparse arched seed stems, irregular soft mound

foliage.name: Meadow fescue clump
foliage.subject: a fresh low fescue grass clump with clearly grouped medium-width blades, muted meadow-green and pale sage highlights, three bent seed stalks, natural open silhouette

foliage.name: Dusky heather
foliage.subject: a low spreading heather bush with tiny painted lilac and dusty mauve flower clusters on olive woody shoots, predominantly foliage, restrained colour not a bright flower bouquet

foliage.name: Cream meadow yarrow
foliage.subject: a knee-high patch of yarrow with fern-like grey green leaves and four flat-topped cream ivory flower clusters at irregular heights, soft warm highlights

foliage.name: Shaded bluebells
foliage.subject: a low fan of broad deep green strap leaves with sparse drooping muted blue-violet bell flowers on curved stalks, natural woodland plant, no neon or saturated purple

foliage.name: Russet dock rosette
foliage.subject: a flattened asymmetric rosette of broad crinkled lance-shaped dock leaves, dark olive centres with occasional muted russet edges and warm golden veins, no flower stalk

foliage.name: Cool creeping ivy
foliage.subject: a low sprawling oval groundcover of small lobed ivy leaves on a few curved crawling tendrils, cool smoky green and dark forest shadows, open gaps around the irregular perimeter

foliage.name: Woodland moss cushions
foliage.subject: one connected low irregular cluster of rounded velvety moss cushions, olive and jade with gentle straw-green tips, crisp painted clumps, tiny curled fern sprout off centre, no rocks or soil platform

foliage.name: Broad river butterbur
foliage.subject: a small cluster of very broad scalloped heart-shaped butterbur leaves on short stalks, dusty cool green with clear veins and blue shadow folds, several sizes and one rolled leaf

foliage.name: Amber blackberry bramble
foliage.subject: a low arching thornless-looking bramble with toothed leaves in restrained amber, olive and moss-green, a handful of dark blackberry clusters, very asymmetric outline and visibly curved canes

props.name: Mossy fallen oak
props.subject: one broad fallen oak log resting horizontally diagonally from lower left to upper right, warm ridged illustrated bark, broken golden end grain facing lower left, moss following the upper ridge, two short broken branch nubs; no loose surrounding props

props.name: Hollow birch log
props.subject: one short fallen hollow birch trunk lying diagonally horizontally, ivory peeling bark with charcoal markings, dark hollow opening at lower right, weathered warm interior wood and restrained moss along the upper surface

props.name: Twisted root snag
props.subject: a weathered fallen broken trunk with a small spreading tangle of thick exposed roots at one end, warm grey-brown carved bark, patches of moss and no canopy, compact wide low silhouette, readable as a natural forest obstacle

props.name: Mossy boulder cluster
props.subject: one low cluster of three irregular rounded woodland boulders of unequal sizes, muted warm grey stone with slate shadow planes, moss in cracks and over upper ledges, softly chipped edges, squat broad silhouette

props.name: Low slate ridge
props.subject: a low rocky crag, broad weathered layered slate ledge with a small asymmetric peak, grey-olive stone with warm sunlit edges and restrained moss seams, about twice as wide as tall, hand-painted angular strata, no huge mountain or snow

props.name: Weathered ochre crag
props.subject: a compact low rocky mound of warm grey sandstone, broken rounded angular slabs forming two unequal humps, ochre and umber cracks with muted sage moss on a few ledges, broad and low not a distant mountain, about twice as wide as tall

trees.name: Amber woodland rowan
trees.subject: a slender crooked woodland rowan tree with an airy asymmetric crown of compound leaf sprays, muted amber olive and russet foliage, small restrained red berry clusters, warm grey-brown ridged trunk, exposed mossy roots

trees.name: River willow
trees.subject: a broad mature river willow with a slightly leaning sturdy warm brown trunk, flowing drooping curtains of narrow sage and blue-green leaves, clear spaces between branch groups, dark jade undersides and mossy roots, NOT a giant round oak crown
